name: Vita3K
requirement: PS Vita emulator (rolling CI build, recorded by file hash). Needs the official firmware (PSVUPDAT.PUP) and font package (PSP2UPDAT.PUP), installed with --firmware. PSN .pkg games install with their zRIF licence. Library Play is not wired yet.

firmware.name: PSVUPDAT.PUP
firmware.note: PS Vita system software from Sony. Stored here, then installed into Vita3K with --firmware.

firmware.name: PSP2UPDAT.PUP
firmware.note: PS Vita font package from Sony; Vita3K uses it for system fonts.
